N: <int> Number of assets available for investment.
S: <int> Number of return scenarios used to estimate portfolio risk.
k: <int> Maximum number of assets that may be held in the portfolio.
beta: <float> Probability level for the conditional value-at-risk measure.
gamma: <float> Regularization strength controlling the penalty on concentrated portfolio weights.
mu_bar: <float> Minimum required expected return that the portfolio must achieve.
mu: <list[float], length N> Expected return for each asset.
p_s: <float> Probability assigned to each return scenario (uniform across all scenarios).
scenarios: <list[list[float]], shape [S][N]> Simulated return of each asset under each scenario.
